mapper.insert: insert into recognize_record (user_id, image_url, disease_id, confidence, create_time) values (#{userId}, #{imageUrl}, #{diseaseId}, #{confidence}, #{createTime})
mapper.select: select r.id, r.image_url, r.confidence, r.create_time, d.crop_name, d.disease_name from recognize_record r left join disease_info d on r.disease_id = d.id where r.user_id = #{userId} order by r.create_time desc
mapper.delete: delete from recognize_record where id = #{id} and user_id = #{userId}
mapper.select: select d.disease_name as name, count(*) as value from recognize_record r left join disease_info d on r.disease_id = d.id where r.user_id = #{userId} group by d.disease_name

SELECT r.id, r.image_url, r.confidence, r.create_time, d.crop_name, d.disease_name FROM recognize_record r LEFT JOIN disease_info d ON r.disease_id = d.id WHERE r.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY r.create_time DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{pageSize}

SELECT r.id, r.image_url, r.confidence, r.create_time, d.crop_name, d.disease_name, c.symptom, c.cause, c.pesticide, c.farming FROM recognize_record r LEFT JOIN disease_info d ON r.disease_id = d.id LEFT JOIN disease_control c ON r.disease_id = c.disease_id WHERE r.id = #{id} AND r.user_id = #{userId}

SELECT DATE(create_time) AS date, COUNT(*) AS count FROM recognize_record WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND DATE(create_time) >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 6 DAY) GROUP BY DATE(create_time) ORDER BY date ASC
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM recognize_record WHERE user_id = #{userId}
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT disease_id) FROM recognize_record WHERE user_id = #{userId}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM recognize_record WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND DATE(create_time) = CURDATE()
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM recognize_record WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND DATE(create_time) >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 6 DAY)
SELECT d.crop_name AS name, COUNT(*) AS value FROM recognize_record r LEFT JOIN disease_info d ON r.disease_id = d.id WHERE r.user_id = #{userId} GROUP BY d.crop_name ORDER BY value DESC
